verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe shows skills are plain markdown folders that can be installed selectively (`--skill test-driven-development --copy`) into ./.claude/skills/, where the SKILL.md reads back cleanly, and the installer warns users to review skills before use. The docs state that everything in `skills/` is the source of truth, shared verbatim, and individual SKILL.md files are publicly readable as raw files before install. Missing for 10: no documented pre-install listing or manifest of all files and scripts a skill adds, no evidence on reviewing hook/bootstrap scripts injected at session start, and the Codex/OpenCode install path has the agent fetch and follow a remote INSTALL.md, which is less reviewable.
